caniuse-lite.reason: Browser-support data table used at build time by browserslist (dev only; its data is not shipped in the built app). Credited here; review if it ever becomes a production dependency.

@csstools/color-helpers.reason: MIT No Attribution: more permissive than MIT. Dev only (jsdom CSS parsing in tests).

ffmpeg-static.reason: Ships prebuilt GPL ffmpeg binaries that FootballOS runs as a separate process (spawned tool, not linked into application code). Not redistributed to end users; the app runs on the staff's own host. Revisit before any binary redistribution.

parse-cache-control.reason: Transitive dependency of ffmpeg-static's installer (@derhuerst/http-basic), used only at npm install time to download the ffmpeg binary. Declares the bare string 'BSD' (BSD-style permissive license, clause count unspecified in package.json). Not loaded by application code.

thirty-two.reason: package.json has no license field; the shipped LICENSE.txt is the MIT license text. Transitive dependency of otplib (@otplib/plugin-thirty-two) used for TOTP base32 encoding.
